items.evidence: Log lines 2-139 show 106/40 µL water/buffer, 4 µL dNTP, 2 µL Q5, 19 µL master mix to A1:G1, 2.5 µL fwd/rev primers paired by well, and 1 µL template from A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1, as specified.
Log lines 198-336 show 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart, 1 µL DpnI and 30 µL mixing in A1:G1; the incubation and Zymo cleanup are recorded by comments and pauses in order.
Log lines 338-488 show 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3/2/3 µL fragments 2/5/6, 2 µL fragments 1,3,4,7 into A1:D1, then 1 µL enzyme mix with mixing after dispensing.

The Golden Gate program (30x 37/16 °C, 60 °C, 4 °C hold) and the cleanup are recorded with protocol.comment plus pauses. Log lines 490-519 show 5 µL into cells A1:D1 and 250 µL LB into each well, with heat shock and recovery recorded as comments.
The move() helper uses new_tip='always', and the log shows a pick up and drop tip around every transfer and each mix, so no tip is shared between fragments or assemblies.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly, and the run log matches the specified volumes, well pairings and order for PCR, DpnI, assembly and transformation. Manual steps are recorded with comments and pauses, and fresh tips are used throughout.
